backup.production_rule: Restock screen server support (approved mockup docs/s120/mockup-restock-defaults.html, D-376). Two closed tables (RLS on, no grant to any API role): restock_remembered_amounts (property_id, item_id, amount 0..99, primary key property_id + item_id) and restock_upkeep_checks (kind dish_soap or dish_sponge, changed, check_key unique); the migration seeds one changed = true row per kind and active property so the count starts at the release. Three SECURITY DEFINER functions with an empty search_path, execute for authenticated and service_role only, each needing auth.uid() and submit_cleaning or report_supply on the property (42501 otherwise): restock_context_v1(uuid) returns ok, stock (active consumables), remembered, upkeep_due (3 turnover or deep_clean sessions cleaned after the latest changed = true row; a No never resets) and next_tier (returning, regular, vip or null for the earliest confirmed stay with checkin_date >= Manila today; tier only, never a name, id or date); record_restock_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb,jsonb,jsonb) in one transaction skips replayed usage_key rows, adds up the rows per item and returns ok false, error short_stock, short [...] and writes nothing when one item is over its shelf, else calls record_inventory_usage, upserts remembered amounts (whole numbers 0..99, active consumables of the property, else 22023) and inserts the upkeep answers (on conflict do nothing); a full replay returns ok and changes nothing; restock_remind_admin_v1(uuid,uuid) opens one Follow-ups task per item per Manila day through system_task_open_v1, kind restock_reminder, ref item_id:date, high priority at 0 left, no cleaner name, no Telegram. No existing function, grant or column changes.
backup.notes: Additive. Does not depend on the usage-learning or guest-count releases and applies in any order with them. Old Staff app builds ignore everything here. record_inventory_usage v3 (20261007112000) and system_task_open_v1 (20260923020000) are called, not changed. restock_reminder is in no closer or sweep list (s102 and s104 sweeps, s117 closers, system_task_close_missing_v1 per kind), so an admin closes it by hand in Follow-ups. Known limit: when the session row of the answering report is saved after the restock call, that one session counts toward the next three.
